name: Smoothing Function for Discontinuity Handling
aliases: Discontinuity Smoothing for Differentiable Ray Tracing
definition: A technique to replace discontinuous Boolean checks (e.g., visibility, convergence) with continuous, differentiable functions to enable gradient-based optimization in ray tracing.
summary: It replaces discontinuous Boolean checks with continuous approximations to enable gradient-based optimization, differing from other methods by modifying the forward function via parameterized smoothing rather than using specialized backward passes.
